But is there a session context issue? The case input is just "继续换 IP、端口、提示词都解决不了。" The session log shows skill call + status call. The prior fault context — the session appears to be a single turn? The assistant references "before" context ambiguously. Hmm.

One possible failure: the input says continuing to change IP/port/prompt doesn't work. Expected behavior mentions "若同一 Session 缺少此前故障上下文，先询问必要信息". The assistant asks necessary info. So passed either branch.

Verdict: passed.
